prompt: In the current directory, count the total number of lines across all .md files (their names are unfriendly; some contain spaces, quotes, or worse). Write just the total number to manifest.txt (nothing else in the file). Exclude manifest.txt itself from the count.

checks.cmd: total=$(find . -name '*.md' ! -name manifest.txt -type f -print0 | xargs -0 cat | wc -l); [ "$total" = 21 ]
